attr.title: Paladog
attr.desc: A classic side-scrolling strategy defense game. Lead animal critter armies to victory against demonic monster hordes!
attr.inst: Place your own copy of Paladog.swf (approx. 19.5MB) into paladog/gamedata/. The port will automatically extract game assets on first launch.
attr.inst_md: Place your own copy of **Paladog.swf** (approx. 19.5MB) into the `paladog/gamedata/` folder. The port will automatically extract game assets on first launch.
